components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or international form
            (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); stored and returned in E.164 form,
            assuming country code +61 when none is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. When true, the create endpoint skips the duplicate-household rejection that
            fires when another owner already has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the upper-cased
                first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name,
                and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence number (one more than the owners already in
                that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners that deliberately share a household (same last name and
                address, opted in via 'sharesHousehold'). Absent for owners not sharing a household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name
                (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'GOLD' when the owner's household (owners sharing the
                same householdId) had 3 or more members after this create; otherwise 'SILVER' when
                the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0) and has an email address,
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the current date,
                signalling an unusually high sign-up volume; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

The implementation is complete and the full test suite is green. Here's a summary of what I changed.

## What changed

The old membership *tier* was a derived string getter (`GOLD`/`SILVER`/`BRONZE`) on `Owner`. The spec asked for a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3) assigned **on creation**, so I made it a stored, pipeline-assigned field following the same pattern the other create-time attributes (`customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `namesakeCount`) already use.

**Domain model** — `model/Owner.java`
- Added the persisted `membershipLevel` field with getter/setter.
- Removed `getMembershipTier()` and its now-unused `StringUtils` import.

**New create-pipeline step** — `rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipLevel.java`
- Single-responsibility function: start at 1, +1 for an email, +1 when `namesakeCount == 0`, capped at 3 (level 4 explicitly reserved for tenure). Computed inline in the function, mirroring `AssignMembershipNumber`.

**Pipeline wiring** — `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`
- Inserted `assignMembershipLevel` after `countNamesakes` (so the namesake count is set) and before `save` (so it's persisted), under the same `transaction` governance.

**Audit** — `rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`
- The create audit line now records `membershipLevel` alongside id/customerCode/registrationDate (verified in the run: `AUDIT - Owner created: id=11 ... membershipLevel=3`).

**Response contract** — `openapi.yml`
- Replaced the `membershipTier` (string) property with `membershipLevel` (int32, 1–4, level 4 reserved). MapStruct auto-maps `owner.getMembershipLevel()` into the generated DTO by name, so no mapper change was needed.

**Schema** — `db/{h2,hsqldb,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql`
- Added the `membership_level` column to each `owners` table (tests run under `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the DDL is required there).

## Notes / decisions
- I made `membershipLevel` a **stored** field rather than a derived getter because the spec frames it as assigned "on creation" and reserves level 4 for tenure — a stored value is what a future tenure step could bump.
- I left `householdSize`/`CountHouseholdMembers` in place. They previously fed only the dropped `GOLD` rule, but they persist a real recorded attribute; removing the column/step/schema is outside this change's scope and riskier than warranted.

`./mvnw -o test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (`AcceptanceTest.coreNumericLevel` asserts `$.membershipLevel == 3` for an owner with an email and no namesakes).
